decks.notes: This Jeskai Control deck focuses on controlling the game through counterspells, removal, and card advantage provided by powerful planeswalkers like Teferi, Hero of Dominaria. The deck utilizes versatile spells like Archmage's Charm and Prismatic Ending to handle a variety of threats, while also having access to board wipes like Supreme Verdict. The deck also includes cards like Snapcaster Mage for additional value and recursion. With a mix of control elements and card advantage, this deck aims to outlast opponents and grind out a win over time in a 1 vs 1 Modern format.

The main strategy of this UR Aggro deck is to play aggressive creatures and control the board with a mix of removal spells and counterspells. While utilizing efficient card draw and card selection to maintain tempo, the deck aims to pressure the opponent with early threats like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Dragon's Rage Channeler, while also presenting threats like Murktide Regent in the mid to late game. The mana base is designed to support the deck's low curve and flexibility in casting both blue and red spells, allowing for a diverse range of responses to the opponent's plays.

This deck focuses on using Indomitable Creativity to cheat giant threats like Emrakul, the Aeons Torn and Iona, Shield of Emeria into play quickly. The deck also utilizes cards like Fable of the Mirror-Breaker and Serra's Emissary to support this combo strategy. The inclusion of various versatile spells like Prismari Command, Lightning Bolt, and Prismatic Ending allows for flexibility in dealing with opposing threats. Teferi, Time Raveler provides disruption while Wrenn and Six offer card advantage. Overall, the deck aims to surprise opponents with unexpected plays and overwhelm them with powerful creatures.

The deck focuses on utilizing Elemental creatures and control spells to disrupt the opponent's game plan while generating value through card advantage and synergy with the Elemental tribe. The deck also includes cards that provide additional consistency and utility such as Abundant Growth and Eladamri's Call. The inclusion of Yorion as a companion allows for additional value through blinking creatures and permanents. The mana base is carefully crafted to support the deck's color requirements and to enable powerful plays with cards like Omnath, Locus of Creation and Wrenn and Six.

The deck focuses on controlling the game by utilizing a variety of powerful removal spells, counterspells, and versatile card draw effects. The inclusion of Yorion as a companion allows for extra value and flexibility, while the main deck features a mix of efficient removal, card advantage engines, and powerful threats like Omnath and Emrakul. The mana base is carefully constructed to ensure consistency and flexibility in casting spells of multiple colors. Overall, the deck aims to outvalue and outmaneuver opponents through careful resource management and efficient threats.

The deck focuses on utilizing aggressive creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Tarmogoyf to quickly put pressure on the opponent. It also includes disruption spells like Thoughtseize and Inquisition of Kozilek to disrupt the opponent's game plan. The deck's removal spells like Fatal Push and Lightning Bolt help control the board while cards like Wrenn and Six provide card advantage and recurring value. The mana base is designed to support the deck's color requirements and includes utility lands like Boseiju, Who Endures to protect key spells.

This UW Control deck focuses on using a combination of counterspells, removal spells, and card advantage engines like Teferi, Hero of Dominaria and Jace, the Mind Sculptor to control the game and outvalue the opponent. The deck also includes powerful finishers like Shark Typhoon and Hall of Storm Giants to close out games. The inclusion of Kaheera, the Orphanguard as a companion adds an additional threat and synergizes well with the overall game plan of the deck. The mana base is designed to provide consistent access to all colors needed for the deck's spells.

The main focus of this deck is to control the game with a variety of counterspells, removal, and board wipes while generating card advantage through card draw and planeswalkers. The deck aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan and stall the game until it can overwhelm the opponent with powerful threats like Shark Typhoon and The Wandering Emperor. The inclusion of Kaheera, the Orphanguard as a companion adds an additional creature and synergy with the deck's control elements. This UW Control archetype excels at out-valuing and outlasting opponents in longer games.

This deck focuses on utilizing Death's Shadow as a powerful threat that grows in size as you take damage. The goal is to quickly cast efficient spells and disrupt the opponent's strategy while keeping your life total low to pump up Death's Shadow. Jegantha, the Wellspring provides additional mana ramp and flexibility. The deck includes a mix of removal spells, hand disruption, and cantrips to maintain tempo and card advantage. With aggressive creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Dragon's Rage Channeler, this deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with early pressure and efficient threats.

This deck utilizes the Hardened Scales mechanic to pump up +1/+1 counters on creatures, creating a fast and aggressive playstyle. With cards like Walking Ballista, Zabaz, the Glimmerwasp, and Arcbound Ravager, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with efficient and powerful creatures. The inclusion of cards like Esper Sentinel and Urza's Saga provide additional utility and card advantage. The deck also features artifact synergy with cards like Hangarback Walker and The Ozolith, allowing for explosive turns and strategic gameplay. Overall, the key concept revolves around quickly building up a strong board presence and putting pressure on the opponent.

This Jeskai Control deck focuses on disruption and card advantage to control the game and outvalue opponents. By using powerful planeswalkers like Teferi, the control player can manipulate the board and hand advantage while also utilizing counter spells and removal to control the opponent's threats. The deck also includes versatile cards like Prismatic Ending and Supreme Verdict to deal with a variety of threats efficiently. With a mix of permission spells, removal, and card advantage engines, this deck aims to outgrind opponents and secure victory through overwhelming control of the game.

The main concept of this Modern 1 vs 1 deck is to utilize the cascade mechanic to cast Living End, which allows the player to return all creatures from their graveyard to the battlefield while forcing their opponent to exile all of their creatures. The deck includes a variety of creatures with cycling abilities to quickly fill the graveyard and enable the combo, as well as disruption spells like Force of Negation to protect the combo. The deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a sudden influx of powerful creatures while disrupting their game plan.

The main concept of this deck is to quickly fill the graveyard with creatures such as Street Wraith and Striped Riverwinder, then cast Living End to bring them all back onto the battlefield. This allows the player to overwhelm their opponent with a board full of powerful creatures while disrupting their game plan with cards like Subtlety and Brazen Borrower. The deck uses a combination of cycling creatures and Cascade spells like Violent Outburst to efficiently execute the combo and control the game.

This deck focuses on quick and aggressive plays utilizing cheap spells and efficient creatures. It aims to control the board while applying pressure with cards like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Murktide Regent. The deck includes a variety of spells to disrupt opponent's game plan or protect its own creatures. It also utilizes cards like Mishra's Bauble and Expressive Iteration to generate card advantage and provide flexibility in its plays. Additionally, the mana base is designed to support the deck's color requirements while maintaining consistency in its aggressive strategy.

The deck focuses on assembling the UrzaTron lands (Urza's Tower, Urza's Power Plant, Urza's Mine) to generate a large amount of mana quickly. It uses control elements like Oblivion Stone and Karn, the Great Creator to disrupt opponents while searching for key threats like Ulamog, the Ceaseless Hunger and Wurmcoil Engine to close out the game. The deck also includes tools like Expedition Map and Ancient Stirrings to help find the necessary components to establish the powerful Tron mana base and out value opponents in the late game.

The deck focuses on controlling the game through a combination of counterspells, removal spells, and planeswalkers to outvalue the opponent. It aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan while drawing cards and generating card advantage to stay ahead in resources. The inclusion of Kaheera as a companion provides additional utility and synergy with the deck's creatures. By efficiently managing threats and answers, the deck aims to outlast the opponent and win through incremental advantage and powerful late-game plays.
